name: HHRG Berhad
overview: HHRG Berhad 今年完成收购 Terengganu Marang 一块土地，并终止另一块土地的买卖协议；同时与 RJJ Hotels 的酒店品牌及管理谅解备忘录经修订后范围扩大至公司未来 earmarked 的酒店或旅游住宿项目。公司亦完成 424,778,675 份凭单的 bonus issue of warrants。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比 -23.4%，净利润同比 -62.7%。
overview_en: HHRG Berhad completed the acquisition of a piece of land in Marang, Terengganu this year, while terminating the sale and purchase agreement for another piece of land. The MOU with RJJ Hotels on hotel brand selection and management was amended to cover any property in upcoming development projects earmarked by HHRG for hotel or tourist accommodation. The company also completed a bonus issue of 424,778,675 warrants. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue fell 23.4% YoY and net profit fell 62.7% YoY.

actions.text: 与 RJJ Hotels Sdn Bhd 的谅解备忘录无重大进展。
actions.text_en: No material development on the MOU with RJJ Hotels Sdn Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Open Road (East Coast) Sdn. Bhd. 完成收购 Terengganu Marang 的 PM 3668, Lot 78303 土地。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Open Road (East Coast) Sdn. Bhd. completed the acquisition of land held under PM 3668, Lot 78303, Marang, Terengganu.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Open Road (East Coast) Sdn. Bhd. 与 Tregon Construction Sdn Bhd 就 PM 3669, Lot 78304 土地的 amended and restated SPA 于 2026 年 8 月 20 日终止，双方同日签订 supplemental letter。
actions.text_en: The amended and restated SPA between Open Road (East Coast) Sdn. Bhd. and Tregon Construction Sdn Bhd for land held under PM 3669, Lot 78304 was terminated on 20 August 2026, with a supplemental letter entered into on the same date.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 RJJ Hotels Sdn Bhd 的谅解备忘录无重大进展。
actions.text_en: No material development on the MOU with RJJ Hotels Sdn Bhd.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 RJJ Hotels Sdn Bhd 修订谅解备忘录，将「Tanjung Residensi located in the state of Terengganu」替换为「any property in upcoming development project(s) earmarked by HHRG for ho…
actions.text_en: Amended the MOU with RJJ Hotels Sdn Bhd by replacing the reference to "Tanjung Residensi located in the state of Terengganu" with "any property in upcoming development project(s) earmarked by HHRG for hotel or tourist accommodation".

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 RJJ Hotels Sdn Bhd 的谅解备忘录涉及 Tanjung Residensi Kuala Terengganu 酒店或旅游住宿的品牌选择及管理，本月公告无重大进展。
actions.text_en: The MOU with RJJ Hotels Sdn Bhd concerns the choice of hotel brand and management of hotel or tourist accommodation at Tanjung Residensi Kuala Terengganu; no material development was announced this month.

segments.name: 集团 / Group

segments.note_en: Completed a bonus issue of 424,778,675 warrants this year, with multiple additional listing announcements.

actions.title: BONUS ISSUE OF 424,778,675 NEW WARRANTS IN HHRG ("WARRANTS") ON THE BASIS OF 2 WARRANTS FOR EVERY 5 EXISTING ORDINARY SHARES IN HHRG ("BONUS
actions.text: 完成 424,778,675 份新凭单的 bonus issue，基准为每 5 股现有普通股获 2 份凭单。
actions.text_en: Completed the bonus issue of 424,778,675 new warrants on the basis of 2 warrants for every 5 existing ordinary shares.
